comment:
* Helper class for keeping track of allowlisted packages/activities. * *

NOTE: this class is not thread safe. * @hide

variables.name: mWhitelistedPackages
variables.comment:
* Map of allowlisted packages/activities. The whole package is allowlisted if its
     * corresponding value is {@code null}.

methods.name: public void setWhitelist(@Nullable ArraySet<String> packageNames, @Nullable ArraySet<ComponentName> components)
methods.comment:
* Sets the allowlist with the given packages and activities. The list is cleared if both
     * packageNames and components are {@code null}.
     *
     * @param packageNames packages to be allowlisted.
     * @param components activities to be allowlisted.
     *
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if packages or components are empty.

methods.name: public void setWhitelist(@Nullable List<String> packageNames, @Nullable List<ComponentName> components)
methods.comment: * Helper to use {@link #setWhitelist(ArraySet, ArraySet)} with {@link List Lists}.

methods.name: public boolean isWhitelisted(@NonNull String packageName)
methods.comment: * Returns {@code true} if the entire package is allowlisted.

methods.name: public boolean isWhitelisted(@NonNull ComponentName componentName)
methods.comment: * Returns {@code true} if the specified activity is allowlisted.

methods.name: public ArraySet<ComponentName> getWhitelistedComponents(@NonNull String packageName)
methods.comment:
* Returns a set of allowlisted components with the given package, or null if nothing is
     * allowlisted.

methods.name: public ArraySet<String> getWhitelistedPackages()
methods.comment:
* Returns a set of all packages that are either entirely allowlisted or have components that
     * are allowlisted.

methods.name: public void dump(@NonNull String prefix, @NonNull String message, @NonNull PrintWriter pw)

methodNames: public void setWhitelist(@Nullable ArraySet<String> packageNames, @Nullable ArraySet<ComponentName> components)
